title: gladiolus splendens
intro: Gladiolus splendens, commonly known as the Red Corn Lily, is a species of flowering plant in the family Iridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Gladiolus splendens include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, while its therapeutic actions include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Gladiolus splendens include iridoids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
